title: Lamb Souvlaki with Tzatziki
description: Lamb shoulder marinated overnight in lemon, oregano, and garlic, then grilled hard and fast. The tzatziki is drained twice so it stays thick instead of sliding off.

steps.text: Toss the lamb shoulder with the olive oil, lemon zest and juice, oregano, crushed garlic, and salt.
steps.tip: Salt in the marinade is doing double duty — it seasons and it keeps the meat juicy.

steps.text: Salt the grated cucumber and leave it in a sieve, then squeeze it dry in a cloth.
steps.tip: Squeeze harder than feels reasonable. Watery tzatziki starts here.

steps.text: Stir the cucumber into the Greek yogurt with the grated garlic, red wine vinegar, and dill.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between the pieces so they colour rather than steam.
Grill over the highest heat you have, turning every couple of minutes.
Rest the skewers before serving with the tzatziki.
